profile.visual_desc: Human in heavy olive-grey robes with a blue tasseled sash and red headpiece. Features a grey face mask with a gold-trimmed visor.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Dramatic close-up of a grey mask. A gold-bordered visor reveals narrow, glowing red eyes with a stern expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Large wooden cudgel held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Front-isometric ↘ stance. Stands upright in robes, holding the wooden staff vertically at his side.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight forward and lowers his center of gravity, pulling the club back for a horizontal strike.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges toward bottom-right, swinging the club in a wide arc. A thick brown motion blur tracks the weapon's trajectory.
profile.step4_finish: Completes the swing in a low crouch as the motion trail dissipates, then returns to a standing position.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The brown motion blur in Frame 4 correctly follows the horizontal arc of the wooden cudgel swing toward the bottom-right.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains mechanical consistency. VFX arcs and wind-up phases align with source intent.
